analysis:
Documentation-only change in docs/reference/configuration.md. The visible changed range is head lines 180-186: line 180 (scheduled serving windows) now says cached Autopilot builds verified at start or by the previous window's provider stay in the set while their bytes hash unchanged. Lines 181-186 add or expand Autopilot set and download settings rows: `[backend.autopilot_downloads]` enabled, max_storage_gb, max_models and reserve_gb, and the `autopilot-downloads.json` ledger. Because the patch excerpt was truncated, I could not confirm exactly which of these rows are new; the range map says they are inside the changed range.

Security-relevant claims examined:
- Autopilot downloads require saved consent.
- Cached builds stay in the set only while their bytes hash unchanged, which supports weight-substitution detection (T-012, T-027, A-004).
- The ledger is owner-only from creation and capped at 256 entries.
- Disk reserve, storage and model caps bound disk-fill exposure (T-016).

The docs do not weaken any documented control or alter the coordinator, attestation or App Attest (TB-011) assumptions. I found no changes to the prefix-cache semantics of T-041. The remaining head lines (e.g. endpoint resumption/logout and worker flags) are unchanged context and were not re-evaluated.

Open question for code-level review: whether the implementation actually matches the documented behavior, including re-hash verification of cached builds at each window and owner-only ledger creation. The implementation is outside the supplied evidence, so I cannot verify it here. No finding is raised from documentation alone.
